evidence.finding: Nail's preset lists Do or Die under Skills Used and separately identifies I must protect Grand Elder Guru! as his Super Soul.
In Xenoverse 2, Do or Die is a Power Up Type Super Skill obtainable from PQ49 and can activate Nail's separate Super Soul.

decision: Do not treat Do or Die as a Super Soul. Preserve placeholder until canonical migration to the Super Skill domain is implemented.
